question: Why is this inner transfer called the supreme consecration even without external pitchers?
premises: The transfer described above is itself declared the supreme consecration.
It is supreme even without external pitchers.
This teaching is stated in the Shri Viravali Bhairava.
inference: The text elevates inner contemplative transfer above external pitcher consecration and grounds this claim in scripture.
plain_english: That itself is declared the supreme consecration, even without external pitchers. This is said in the Shri Viravali Bhairava.
